name: When should I get a roof valley assessment?

mainEntity.name: When should I get a roof valley assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a roof valley assessment if you notice water stains on your ceiling, missing or damaged shingles in valley areas, excessive moss or debris buildup, or after a significant storm with heavy rain or hail. It's also a good idea to include it as part of a routine roof inspection, typically every 1-3 years, especially if your home is older or has complex rooflines. Early detection of valley issues can prevent more extensive and costly water damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Get a roof valley assessment if you see signs of leaks, damage, or buildup, or as part of a routine inspection every 1-3 years.
